title: Mechanical properties of bidimensional T-loop closing springs compared with conventional T-loops: A 3-dimensional finite element analysis
html: T-loop closing springs are widely used for extraction space closure in friction-free orthodontic mechanics. The bidimensional technique exploits differential wire-slot engagement to enhance anterior torque control; however, its application to T-loop design has not been investigated. This study aimed to compare the 3-dimensional force systems produced by conventional and bidimensional T-loop closing springs across different interbracket distances and activation levels using finite element analysis.
